notes:
Status: Closed-lost to Together. Short summary:
- Customer: mid-stage data analytics firm focused on regulated finance products. Wanted private/VPC offering for document understanding + semantic search across client contracts.
- Primary drivers for Redwood: production SLOs, Dedicated predictability, observability.
- Why lost: cost & speed. Engineering liked Redwood tech but procurement prioritized lower initial spend + Together offered easy on-prem bundle and more flexible license terms. Security team flagged our longer SOC2/ISO alignment timeline vs vendor who had a pre-approved on-prem package.
- Champion: Director of Platform (Michael Grove) initially drove evaluation but was promoted and left the company mid-process — no replacement champion.
- Security blocker details: Lantern required conditional key ownership (HSM-backed KMS) and 12-month audit log retention on-prem; our Private roadmap covers these but delivery timelines slipped. Security review ticket INF-3291 escalated.
- Sales notes / quote: Final pricing felt >20% over their cap; procurement opened negotiation with Together and got a staged rollout discount.
- Feedback to product: faster Private on-prem installer and clearer HSM/KMS compliance checklist would have helped. Also request for lower-commitment Dedicated burst credits for proof-of-value.
- Next actions: Close-won flag cleared; add to churn watchlist; schedule 6-month check-in in case of customer regret or migration opportunity.
Quoted lines from Lantern: "We need something we can stand up on-prem in weeks, not months. Price beats everything for now."
CRM shorthand: "won't pursue — lost to Together; procurement freeze earlier than expected; security closure required HSM support; no regen champion."
